panels.title: Protocol verdicts per server (worst-blocked first)
panels.description: Worst-of-session per (server, protocol). Sorted by BLOCKED count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tr.test_id AS server,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pr.verdict='BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_count,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='openvpn' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='openvpn' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='openvpn' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS openvpn,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='wireguard' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='wireguard' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='wireguard' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS wireguard,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='amneziawg' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='amneziawg' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='amneziawg' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS amneziawg,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='shadowsocks' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='shadowsocks' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='shadowsocks' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS shadowsocks,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='vless_reality' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='vless_reality' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='vless_reality' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS vless_reality,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='hysteria2' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='hysteria2' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='hysteria2' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS hysteria2,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_proxy' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_proxy' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_proxy' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS mtproto_proxy,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_proxy_alt' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_proxy_alt' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_proxy_alt' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS mtproto_proxy_alt,
  CASE
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_orig' AND pr.verdict='BLOCKED') THEN 'BLOCKED'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_orig' AND pr.verdict='HANDSHAKE_ONLY') THEN 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY'
    WHEN BOOL_OR(pr.protocol='mtproto_orig' AND pr.verdict='OK') THEN 'OK'
  END AS mtproto_orig
FROM test_runs tr
JOIN listener_sessions ls ON ls.test_run_id = tr.id
JOIN protocol_results pr ON pr.session_id = ls.id
WHERE
    (('Mobile' IN (${var_client_network:singlequote}) AND ls.is_mobile)
     OR ('Whitelist' IN (${var_client_network:singlequote}) AND ls.is_whitelist)
     OR ('Regular' IN (${var_client_network:singlequote}) AND NOT ls.is_mobile AND NOT ls.is_whitelist))
    AND (COALESCE(tr.server_meta->'asn'->>'org', '— (no solo)') IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
GROUP BY tr.test_id
ORDER BY blocked_count DESC, tr.test_id

panels.title: Protocols OK (%) per server × client network
panels.description: % of protocols verdict=OK per server, split by mobile/whitelist/regular client networks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tr.test_id AS server,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.is_mobile AND pr.verdict='OK')
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.is_mobile), 0), 1) AS "Mobile",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.is_whitelist AND pr.verdict='OK')
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.is_whitelist), 0), 1) AS "Whitelist",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ls.is_mobile AND NOT ls.is_whitelist AND pr.verdict='OK')
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ls.is_mobile AND NOT ls.is_whitelist), 0), 1) AS "Regular"
FROM test_runs tr
JOIN listener_sessions ls ON ls.test_run_id = tr.id
JOIN protocol_results pr ON pr.session_id = ls.id
WHERE (COALESCE(tr.server_meta->'asn'->>'org', '— (no solo)') IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
GROUP BY tr.test_id
ORDER BY tr.test_id
